title: Nobody's Child (sequenced H. de Koning)
lyrics_plain:
I was slowly passing.
An orphanage one day.
And stopped there for a moment.
To watch the children play.
A lone boy was standing.
And when I asked him why.
He turned with eyes that could not see.
And he began to cry.
I'm nobody's child.
I'm nobody's child.
Just like a flower.
I am growing wild.
No mommy's kisses.
And no daddy's smile.
Nobody wants me.
I'm nobody's child.
People come for children.
To take them for their own.
But they all seem to pass me by.
And I am left alone.
I know they'd like to take me.
But when they see I'm blind.
They always take some other child.
And I am left behind.
I'm nobody's child.
I'm nobody's child.
Just like a flower.
I am growing wild.
No mommy's kisses.
And no daddy's smile.
Nobody wants me.
I'm nobody's child.
No mothers arms to hold
Or hug me when I cry.
Sometimes I get so lonely here.
I wish that I could die.
I walked the streets of heaven.
Where all the blind can see.
And just like all the other kids.
That will be a home for me.
I'm nobody's child.
I'm nobody's child.
Just like a flower.
Ooh I'm growing wild.
No mommy's kisses.
And no daddy's smile.
Nobody wants me.
I'm nobody's child.
I'm nobody's child.
I'm nobody's child.
Just like a flower.
I am growing wild.
No mommy's kisses.
And no daddy's smile.
Nobody wants me.
I'm nobody's child.
